gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-hind-siligur: Early GameBoy spaces its letters wide and leans on heavier stems. Hind Siliguri follows with one fixed nib's worth of line, gapped rounds and a gentle hum of constant weight beneath the louder heading.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-inter-tight: Wide-set and softly curved, Early GameBoy takes the lead with some swagger. Inter Tight, a sans-serif of rope-like lines and stubby ascenders, moves through paragraph after paragraph tightly and quietly.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-kedebideri: A skyward x-height and generous letterspacing give Early GameBoy its playful, commanding stance across every line it sets. Kedebideri, a sans with rounded, open letters, keeps the whole pairing approachable.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-khula: Spaced-out, swaggering Early GameBoy goes first, mellow in its thick-thin shifts. Khula brings a tall, brush-belly midsection and open-mouthed curves, and that modern openness is the pair's real strength.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-krub: Wide-spaced and cheeky, Early GameBoy steps up with real swagger. Krub, a sans with pen-lifted, unfinished curves and a pronounced x-height, keeps a full page of text moving without strain.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-lexend: Lexend, a plain sans of outsized lowercase and open-jawed curves, sits beneath Early GameBoy and its light stroke variation. Its thread-like line glides through text without a snag.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-mada: Wide, cocky letterforms define Early GameBoy at a glance. Mada, a sans with curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, leaves the heading to do its big, short work.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-maven-pro: Stretched out and cheeky, Early GameBoy carries heavier stems than crossbars, which gives its capitals a stubborn little swagger. Maven Pro hums along in a gentle monotone, smooth over many lines.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-michroma: Commanding and playful, Early GameBoy takes charge up top. Michroma, a contemporary sans-serif with wide berth around every letter and stubby ascender tips, gives that swagger room to breathe.
